RHF.TABLES.txt - Roothaan-Hartree-Fock ground-state STO wave functions, He-Xe, as
published in

  C. F. Bunge, J. A. Barrientos, A. V. Bunge,
  Atomic Data and Nuclear Data Tables 53, 113-162 (1993)
  doi:10.1006/adnd.1993.1003

Machine-readable transcription formerly distributed at
http://www.tcm.phy.cam.ac.uk/~mdt26/RHF.TABLES.txt (M. D. Towler, Cambridge);
this copy was retrieved from the Internet Archive snapshot of 2005-04-13
(http://web.archive.org/web/20050413204954/...). The numbers are the published
tables; cite the paper above when using them. gpucohp turns them into
gpucohp/basis_data/bunge.lobster with tools/make_bunge_basis.py.
